credit: Creative direction: Ahimanikya Satapathy. Original SVG construction: AI-assisted design study for Kabita Live.

icons.name: Earth & voice
icons.story: Rain meets soil; a quiet voice rises. A companion to the signature, never a replacement for the logo.
icons.use: Our Story or an editorial opening

icons.name: A leaf remembers
icons.story: A tied palm-leaf manuscript suggests words carried across generations.

icons.name: A thread becomes a line
icons.story: A loose fold and stepped diamond allude to Sambalpuri weaving; this is an original abstraction, not a reproduced textile pattern.

icons.name: The cloth of everyday life
icons.story: An everyday checked cloth, folded over a line: a poetic study prompted by Puri gamucha. It does not claim a unique traditional weave.

icons.name: In the kendu shade
icons.story: A broad oval leaf and a second young leaf suggest kendu woodland generally, as requested. Stylised, not a botanical identification plate.

icons.name: The forest keeps its breath
icons.story: Layered broadleaf canopies and a small watercourse evoke Similipal without turning the forest into a tiger badge.

icons.name: The hills leave room
icons.story: Two open ridges and low cloud suggest Deomali and Koraput. This is landscape shorthand, not a topographic silhouette.

icons.name: A wing over water
icons.story: A single migrating wing over lagoon lines: arrival, departure and the space between.

icons.name: When rain begins
icons.story: Two drops and a light streak meet a ripple. A small seasonal pause, not a weather forecast.

icons.name: A little light remains
icons.story: A clay lamp and a single flame: an evening held open for another page.

icons.name: A small boat, a long memory
icons.story: A slender sail and river line evoke Odisha’s boat-memory. Original drawing; distinct from Utkal’s book-and-boat emblem.

icons.name: A welcome on the threshold
icons.story: A rice-paste-inspired flowering gesture. An original decorative study, not a ritual diagram.
icons.use: A rare welcome or section end

icons.name: Water kept cool
icons.story: An earthen vessel holds the memory of a shaded courtyard.

icons.name: What the soil gives
icons.story: A bending stem and grain suggest the patient work behind a harvest.
